contexts.text: There rose... many Spirits from the unlearned common people... SE 3531.
Merely for the sake of the common people...
There are Spirits who correspond to unclean excretions... Many of these were from the lowest of the common people...
Their talk had been like that of the lowest of the common people, but still more filthy...
The common idea in Christendom about God is as of a Man... But they who are more sapient than the common people declare for an invisible God...
Let us take a common idea, which also is for the common people...
On the lowest of the common people.
